readerCopy.headline: A bigger option can make the life you already built look suddenly too small.
readerCopy.body:
Someone else's offer, belief, or plan may make another future look possible very quickly. You can become aware of what is missing in the life you already have, or feel impatient with a direction that seemed perfectly reasonable last month. Both futures can look convincing from where you are standing.

Jupiter opposite Jupiter can make comparison inflate the difference between what you have and what is possible. Do not discard a working life just because a larger option appeared. Compare the actual time, money, responsibility, and consequences attached to each direction before choosing the one with more shine.
doNotAssume: Do not assume a break, move, career change, or that the outside option should win.
